mapper.select: WITH first_facts AS ( SELECT k.domain, min(f.occurred_at) AS first_occurred_at FROM (VALUES ('REVIEW','REVIEW_SUBMITTED'), ('REVIEW','REVIEW_APPROVED'), ('REVIEW','REVIEW_REJECTED'), ('REVIEW','REVIEW_WITHDRAWN'), ('REVIEW','REVIEW_CANCELLED'), ('REVIEW','VERSION_PUBLISHED'), ('COMMENT','COMMENT_CREATED'), ('COMMENT','COMMENT_REPLIED'), ('COMMENT','COMMENT_DELETED')) k(domain, kind) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT occurred_at FROM kb_collaboration_event WHERE kind = k.kind ORDER BY occurred_at LIMIT 1 ) f ON true GROUP BY k.domain ) SELECT coalesce(c.domain, e.domain) AS domain, c.protocol_version AS "protocolVersion", c.started_at AS "startedAt", e.first_occurred_at AS "firstOccurredAt" FROM kb_collaboration_coverage c FULL JOIN first_facts e ON c.domain = e.domain WHERE c.domain IS NOT NULL OR e.first_occurred_at IS NOT NULL
